_doc: Pokémon Emerald's Trainer Hill for Pokémon Emerald NDS (battle_tents, 2026-10-18; notes/BATTLE_TENTS.md) -> data/emerald/trainer_hill.json: the four base-game modes (Normal, Variety, Unique, Expert), each 4 floors of two trainers (their names, classes, speeches and three Pokémon each), the floors' 16x16 layouts (metatiles, collision), the trainers' spots, facing and sight; the prize lists and the owner's rules. b2tools/patches/trainer_hill.py writes the battle data into the ROM; the floor rooms' builder reads the layouts and spots.
